name: strata-desktop
description: Strata Desktop - local AI, tuned to one model.

scripts.build:ui: npm run stage:bundle && npm run stage:companion && npm --prefix ../host run build
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && tauri build && npm run check:app
scripts.build:app: npm run build:ui && tauri build --bundles app && npm run check:app
scripts.dmg: npm run build:ui && tauri build --bundles dmg && npm run check:app
